prompt: State Newton's first law of motion.

mark_scheme.criterion: States: a body remains at rest or continues at constant velocity unless acted on by a resultant force. (Allow uniform motion in a straight line for constant velocity).

hints: Use the exact controlled definition from Cambridge 9702.
Remember to mention both remaining at rest and continuing at constant velocity.
solution: A body remains at rest or continues at constant velocity unless acted on by a resultant force.
teacher_walkthrough: Cambridge 9702 awards the mark for exact recall of Newton's first law.
Key terms: 'remains at rest', 'continues at constant velocity', and 'unless acted on by a resultant force'.
Writing 'no force' instead of 'no resultant force' loses the mark.
